newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador sugar crop seen up 40,000 T to 350,000.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador sugar crop seen up 40,000 T to 350,000.

text.p: El Salvador's 1996-1997 sugar harvest is expected to produce 40,000 tonnes more than the 310,000-tonne output in 1995-1996, reaching a total of 350,000 tonnes, the National Sugar Association said Monday.
Mario Salaverria, the manager of the association, said the favorable outlook came in spite of recent losses incurred because of fire damage in cane fields.
Salaverria said the association had asked for army and police protection for crops which have been the target of random vandalism and accidents.
